name: Annette Kellerman
role: Australian swimmer, vaudeville star, film actress and writer
legacy: This person's swimming costumes became so popular that she started her own fashion line of one-piece bathing suits.

checks.lead: Annette Marie Sarah Kellermann (6 July 1886 – 6 November 1975) was an Australian professional swimmer, vaudeville star, film actress, and writer, usually spelt with a single final n as Annette Kellerman.
